DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S
MOTION TO DISQUALIFY MAGISTRATE JUDGE IVAN D. DAVIS

I, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows:

1. I am the Plaintiff in this action. I proceed pro se. I have personal knowledge of the
facts stated in this Declaration.

2. After the Order entered October 7, 2026 (ECF No. 84), I learned that the annual
financial disclosure reports of Magistrate Judge Ivan D. Davis for calendar years 2024 and 2025 list
an asset described as “FB common stock.” I had no knowledge of that reported holding when ECF
No. 84 was entered or at any earlier point in this action. I prepared this Declaration and the Motion
it supports promptly after learning of it.

3. I obtained both reports from the Financial Disclosure Reports database maintained
by the Administrative Office of the United States Courts and made available to the public on the

federal judiciary’s website.

4. Exhibit A to the Motion is a true and correct copy of the report for calendar year
2025 as I retrieved it from that database. Exhibit B to the Motion is a true and correct copy of the
report for calendar year 2024 as I retrieved it from that database. I have not altered either document.

I declare under penalty of perjury under 28 U.S.C. § 1746 that the foregoing is true and
correct.

Executed on October 13, 2026.
